Roots lift your companion as warmth drains from your hands. The branches bend toward you, giving them a way back into the line.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing.
Type
Magic / Recovery / Movement

Pay 3 HP and make a Reason healing roll.

Weak
Restore 5 HP; the recipient may move 1 square toward you without provoking.
Standard
Restore 9 HP; it may move 2 squares toward you without provoking.
Strong
Restore 13 HP; it may move 3 squares toward you without provoking.

A recipient receiving beneficial healing may stand before this movement.

Source: design/cards/a-bough-for-the-fallen.md at f3fb98ca03b046335fcc730c1b05689bebf091b4.
